issues.title: [Bug]: 'self' in a method or init parameter default compiles, then crashes at runtime
issues.output:
error: interface conversion: values.BalValue is nil, not *values.List
        at main(i1659a.bal:5)
           main(i1659a.bal:11)
(method-default variant crashes the same way; --dump-bir shows BIR generated for the invalid program)
issues.edge_case_reason: `self` inside a parameter default of a method/init is a rarely used, invalid construct
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main. Validity agent: VALID — `self` is only bound in method bodies (§6.8.1.2); a default closure may refer only to previous parameters (§5.5.2), so a compile error is required. Front end accepts the invalid program and emits BIR (wrong), runtime then crashes -> frontend (missing diagnostic). Not frontend-crash (crash is at runtime). Fix PR #1663 is open. Related: #1151 (different trigger).

issues.title: [Bug]: object field override errors report one member, chosen by map iteration order
issues.output:
error[SEMANTIC_ERROR]: member 'a' that overrides included member is not a subtype of the included member type
 --> i1658.bal:8:5
(only one error; no error for 'b'. In 8 runs here it always reported 'a', so the nondeterminism did not show locally, but the missing second diagnostic reproduces every time)
issues.edge_case_reason: needs two incompatible overrides of included object fields in one type; only error-reporting completeness is affected
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main (one diagnostic instead of two). Validity agent: VALID — each overriding field must be a subtype of the overridden one, so both `a` and `b` are independent errors. Missing diagnostic -> frontend. No duplicate found.

issues.title: [Bug]: object field initializer can read a mutable module variable when the class has no init
issues.edge_case_reason: plain class field initializer reading a module variable; ordinary code
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main. Validity agent: VALID — §6.8.1.1: field-initializer must meet isolated-function requirements unless a non-isolated init is present; C has no init, so reading mutable module var `value` must be an error (and the read precedes definite assignment, §8.7). Missing diagnostic -> frontend. Related but different: #1629 (isolated class), #1636/#1637 (module var read before init assigns it).

issues.title: [Bug]: module init that returns an error on one path reports a module variable as not initialized
issues.output:
error[SEMANTIC_ERROR]: variable 'value' is not initialized
 --> i1656.bal:4:5
issues.edge_case_reason: module init returning error? with an early error return is a common pattern
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main. Validity agent: VALID (fairly confident) — every normally-completing path of init assigns `value`; an error return makes module init fail (§8.4) so the error path need not assign it. Valid program rejected -> frontend. Module-level counterpart of #1223 (class init); not a duplicate. Related: #972.

issues.title: [Bug]: action in a query join or collect clause is rejected as a syntax error
issues.output:
error[SYNTAX_ERROR]: expression expected action found
 --> i1651a.bal:7:64
error[SYNTAX_ERROR]: expression expected action found
 --> i1651b.bal:7:53
issues.edge_case_reason: action (wait) as the operand of a query join/collect clause is a rarely used construct
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main. Validity agent: VALID — 2024R1 join-action-clause (`join ... in action-or-expr`) and collect-action-clause (`collect action-or-expr`) allow actions; outputs [2,3] and 1. Valid program rejected by the parser -> frontend. Related: #1556, #1244.

issues.title: [Bug]: invalid UTF-8 and disallowed code points in source string literals are accepted
issues.edge_case_reason: raw invalid UTF-8 bytes / disallowed code points in source text
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main. Validity agent: VALID — §4 requires source to be RFC 3629 UTF-8 and forbids surrogates, non-characters, C0 (except whitespace) and C1 controls; all listed cases must be rejected. Missing lexer diagnostic -> frontend. Related: #1456, #1619.

issues.title: [Bug]: `isolated function` type without a signature ignores the `isolated` qualifier
issues.output:
true
false
(second program compiles, exit 0). --dump-bir shows `%3 = a is function` — the isolated qualifier is dropped in BIR.
issues.edge_case_reason: signature-less `isolated function` type descriptor is rarely used
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main. Validity agent: VALID — bump mutates a module variable so it is not isolated; `a is isolated function` must be false and assigning to `isolated function` must be a type error. BIR is wrong (type test lowered to `is function`) and the compile-time check is missing -> frontend. Related but different: #1652 (intersection with isolated function type), #1072.

issues.title: [Bug]: compiler stack overflow when a parameter default calls its own function
issues.output:
runtime: goroutine stack exceeds 1000000000-byte limit
fatal error: stack overflow
issues.edge_case_reason: parameter default that recursively calls its own function
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main: Go stack overflow in the front end (type resolution of the signature). Validity agent: VALID — default may reference previous parameters and module-level names; rec(3) = 6. Front-end crash -> frontend + frontend-crash. Not a duplicate of #1618 or #1483.

undetermined.reasoning: Re-triaged because a comment was added after the 2026-11-05 report. Still present on main 7844a7b: utf16Offset (ls/server/documents.go:55-65) loops to position.Line and nextLineStart (93-96) returns (start, true) once start >= len(text), so a huge client line number spins for billions of iterations. Valid language-server bug, but none of langlib/library/frontend/runtime applies; suggest a language-server label. Fix PR #1664 (open, not merged) was posted in the new comment.

notes: All 9 language issues reproduce on main 7844a7b and were judged valid by a clean-context subagent working from the 2024R1 spec. None had a duplicate. None has sub-issues.
